problem_statement:
feat(browser): add opt-in browser_* tools (Playwright)

navigate/click/type/read/screenshot against a real, JS-rendered
Chromium session -- fetch_url only ever sees static HTML, so SPAs,
dashboards, and local dev-server frontends need an actual browser.
One lazily-launched session per process (cookies/login persist across
calls), closed at exit. click/type go through the safety gate like
every other mutating tool; navigate/read/screenshot are read-only,
same as fetch_url. Screenshots route through the new vision-profile
routing (MODEL_PROFILE_VISION) automatically to get a text
description back, even when the active model isn't vision-capable.

Off by default (WELLS_BROWSER=0) since it pulls in Playwright + a
downloaded Chromium binary -- new 'browser' optional-dependency group
in pyproject.toml. Tests cover registration/gating without a real
browser plus a live-Chromium suite that self-skips when Playwright/
Chromium aren't installed (16 tests total, 10 always run).

Also documents this + MODEL_PROFILE_VISION's /config CRUD in README.
